extraction_hint:
This is the Signal (Vancouver) /suites page (RentSync floorplan-navigator). Its per-unit listings are flattened into a plain-text dump appended to the page, starting with "=== SIGNAL PER-UNIT LISTINGS ===". Each line is one available unit:
  Unit <n> | <beds> | <baths> | <sqft> | <rent>
Example:
  Unit 1 | 2 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | 1061 sqft | $3740
  Unit 2 | Studio | 1 Bathroom | 440 sqft | $2050

EXTRACTION RULES:
1. Emit ONE ROW PER unit line in the "=== SIGNAL PER-UNIT LISTINGS ===" dump.
2. For each line:
   - unit_type from beds: "Studio" -> "bachelor", "1 Bedroom" -> "1-bed", "1 Bedroom + Den" -> "1-bed+den", "2 Bedrooms" -> "2-bed", "2 Bedrooms + Den" -> "2-bed+den", "3 Bedrooms" -> "3-bed", "3 Bedrooms + Den" -> "3-bed+den"; a "Townhome" maps to its bed count.
   - bathrooms: the number only (strip "Bathroom"/"Bathrooms").
   - square_footage: integer from "NNN sqft".
   - rent_price: the per-unit <rent> on the SAME line (strip "$" and commas). This is the real unit rent -- do NOT use the promotional "Starting From" list for rent.
   - rent_psf: rent_price / square_footage.
   - notes: "Unit <n>".
3. Ignore the [PROMOTIONAL CONTEXT] "Starting From Pricing" block for per-unit rents -- it is building-wide marketing only; never emit rows from it.
4. If a unit lacks sqft, still emit the row with square_footage=null.
5. Ignore cookie banners, tour/booking forms, leasing-office info, and footer legal text.

Also capture current building-wide incentives (e.g., "Sign a 12-month lease and get a MacBook Neo" or "1 Month Free"). The MacBook offer is valid March 20 - August 31, 2026.
